experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and glacial moraines while enjoying breathtaking views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli peaks. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural immersion alongside stunning Himalayan scenery.
experiences.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chhomrong to ABC route

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Viewpoint Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill at 3,210m for one of the most celebrated sunrise panoramas in the Himalayas. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges in a spectacular 180-degree view. The 2-hour ascent from Ghorepani is manageable for most fitness levels and rewards trekkers with unforgettable photography opportunities.
experiences.location: Ghorepani, Poon Hill, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay Experience
experiences.description: Stay overnight in a traditional Gurung family home in the village of Ghandruk, one of the largest Gurung settlements in Nepal. Share home-cooked dal bhat, learn about indigenous customs, explore the Gurung Museum, and witness traditional dance performances. This immersive experience provides deep insight into the ancient culture of the Himalayan hill tribes.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek and High Camp Nature Walk
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-trodden Mardi Himal trail, a hidden gem offering solitude and raw Himalayan nature. Trek through dense bamboo and rhododendron forests teeming with wildlife including Himalayan tahr and red pandas. Reach High Camp at 3,580m for close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain) and the Annapurna massif without the crowds of the main circuit.
experiences.location: Mardi Himal Trail, Lwang to High Camp

experiences.name: Pokhara Lakeside Food and Nature Day
experiences.description: Spend a rest day in Pokhara exploring the vibrant Lakeside district. Kayak or take a rowboat on the serene Phewa Lake with Annapurna reflections on the water, then visit the World Peace Pagoda for panoramic views. End the day sampling authentic Nepali cuisine including momos, thukpa, and sel roti at local teahouses along Lakeside Road, fueling up for the next trekking stage.
